entities.summary: Duhok Stadium (Arabic: ملعب دهوك) is a multi-use stadium in Dohuk, Kurdistan Region, Iraq. It is currently used mostly for football matches and serves as the home stadium of Duhok SC which plays in the Iraqi Premier League. The stadium has a capacity of 22,800.
